mechanism.claim: After an extreme completed Cboe VIX move, an overnight BTC move through 10:00 ET in the usual opposite risk direction confirms cross-market transmission; the confirmed BTC direction should continue for six hours.
mechanism.eligible: strict-prior rank(abs(delta log VIX))>=0.75 and sign(BTC overnight return)==-sign(delta log VIX)
mechanism.why_distinct: CVOBR combines an official external volatility shock with a causally completed BTC overnight confirmation; prior Cboe candidates used no pre-entry BTC confirmation and prior intraday candidates had no Cboe clock.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: next-Cboe-session 10:05 ET entries after extreme external shocks are absent from Gross9

features.vix_change: current Cboe close minus immediately prior exact common source row in log space
features.vix_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank over 252 valid changes, minimum 126; current appended after rank
features.overnight_btc: return from the BTC hour_open at source date 16:00 America/New_York through hour_close of [09:00,10:00) America/New_York on the next exact Cboe source date
features.availability: all BTC bars completed by 10:00 ET; entry five minutes later

clock.entry: next exact Cboe source date 10:05 America/New_York
